key_findings: 100% accuracy in blind evaluation — all 10 errors detected, all 5 correct cases confirmed
3 items detected in blind that were MISSED in contaminated eval: S5_E5, S6_E2, S2_E3
Same 3 items were also missed by domain expert (80% accuracy)
Contamination paradox: knowing case names DECREASED accuracy (87% vs 100%)
VLM excels when problem setup is explicitly stated — can cross-reference setup text vs visual

comparison.hypothesis: Blind VLM benefits from systematic cross-referencing of problem setup text against visual features (e.g., checking if stated wall temperature matches colorbar values). Human experts may rely more on gestalt visual impression and miss quantitative inconsistencies.
